page.title: API Keys
page.description: These keys can be used to read and write data to Helicone. Please do not share these keys and make sure you store them somewhere secure.

table.emptyAction: Click here to generate a Helicone key

modal.rateLimitTooltip: This will prefix the key with "rl-" and apply rate limits configured in the dashboard.
modal.yourKeyDescription: Please copy this key and store it somewhere safe. You will not be able to see it again.
modal.yourKeyDescriptionFull: This will be the only time you can see your API key. Please save it somewhere safe and accessible. If you lose your API key, you will need to generate a new one.
modal.deleteDescription: This Helicone key will be deleted from your account. You will no longer be able to use this for your API requests. Are you sure you want to delete this key permanently?

notifications.enterKeyName: Please enter in a key name
